title: Reverse Grip Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
overview: The reverse grip preacher curl with EZ bar is a variation of thepreacher curland an exercise used to isolate the biceps.The angle used when performing preacher curl variations allows for a more focused concentric portion of the curl. This is especially helpful when trying to build bicep peaks and promote a pump in the biceps. The reverse grip hand positioning will naturally make the biceps more involved in the exercise.The dumbbell preacher curl would be an exercise primarily used by bodybuilders to help build bigger biceps. It is an isolation movement that is best used towards the end of yourworkoutsif your goal is building a more aesthetic physique.
instructions: Setup for the exercise by adjusting the seat height of the preacher bench so that the back of your upper arms rest flat on the pads.
Select an EZ bar, grasp it using a pronated grip (palms facing down), and sit on the bench.
Keeping your arms fixed, curl the weight until your forearms are around 90 degrees to the floor.
Do not pause, and slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.
tips: Keep the rep timing slow and control the weight throughout the movement.
Keep your wrists straight - do not allow them to sag forward.
